description: Election Commission - Gallage Lasantha De Silva was Selected as the Member of the Ambalangoda Pradeshiya Sabha, Abeysinghe Kodippili Patabendige Vijith Chandima was Elected as the Member of the No. 03 Madaketiya of Tangalle Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Ambalangoda Pradeshiya Sabha and Tangalle Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including the declaration of elected members to fill seats vacated due to party membership cessation, which falls under Election-related matters.
